question.en: Analyze how the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme can help India transition into a global manufacturing hub.
question.hi: Analyze how the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme can help India transition into a global manufacturing hub.

modelAnswer.en: The PLI scheme addresses the 'missing middle' in Indian manufacturing by incentivizing scale, reducing import dependency, fostering R&D, and integrating India into global supply chains.
